verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer docs describe a searchable, filterable reference for the full v2 REST API, plus a quickstart for making a first authenticated call to List companies. That shows a first-party, explorable API reference with guided example calls. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples can run in the docs (e.g., a try-it console). missing for 10: an in-docs try-it/runnable request console, runnable code samples per endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
